```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(DBI)
library(RSQLite)
library(data.table)
library(here)

# Set knitr options for memory efficiency
knitr::opts_chunk$set(
  echo = FALSE,
  message = FALSE,
  warning = FALSE,
  results = 'asis',
  cache = FALSE
)

db_path <- file.path(here("output"), "legislation.db")
conn <- dbConnect(SQLite(), dbname = db_path)

# Load tables
legislation_table <- as.data.table(dbReadTable(conn, "LegislationMetadata"))
provision_table <- as.data.table(dbReadTable(conn, "LegislationParagraphs"))
provision_label_table <- as.data.table(dbReadTable(conn, "provision_label_table"))

dbDisconnect(conn)

# Filter for Provincial Acts only
legislation_table <- legislation_table[jurisdiction == "Provincial" & legislation_type == "Act"]

# Clean up memory
invisible(gc())
```

```{r label-tally-by-scope}
# Get provision IDs for Provincial Acts
provincial_act_provision_ids <- merge(
  provision_table[, .(provision_id, legislation_id)],
  legislation_table[, .(legislation_id)],
  by = "legislation_id"
)$provision_id

# Create tally of labels by scope for Provincial Acts only
scope_tally <- provision_label_table[
  provision_id %in% provincial_act_provision_ids & !is.na(scope) & scope != "", 
  .N, 
  by = scope
]
setorder(scope_tally, scope)

cat("# Labels by Scope - Provincial Acts\n\n")

if (nrow(scope_tally) > 0) {
  cat("| Scope | Count |\n")
  cat("|-------|-------|\n")
  
  for (i in seq_len(nrow(scope_tally))) {
    cat(sprintf("| %s | %d |\n", scope_tally[i]$scope, scope_tally[i]$N))
  }
  
  cat(sprintf("\n**Total Labels:** %d\n\n", sum(scope_tally$N)))
} else {
  cat("No scope labels found in the data.\n\n")
}

# Clean up
rm(scope_tally, provincial_act_provision_ids)
invisible(gc())
```

```{r display-hierarchy-with-labels}
# Create comprehensive provision dataset with legislation metadata
provision_with_metadata <- merge(
  provision_table[, .(provision_id, legislation_id, Paragraph, Section, Heading)],
  legislation_table[, .(legislation_id, jurisdiction, legislation_type, act_name, legislation_name)],
  by = "legislation_id",
  all.x = TRUE
)

# Clean up intermediate objects
rm(provision_table, legislation_table)
invisible(gc())

# Display hierarchy - Provincial Acts only
cat("# Provincial Acts\n\n")

acts <- unique(provision_with_metadata$act_name)
acts <- acts[!is.na(acts)]

for (act in acts) {
  cat(sprintf("## %s\n\n", act))
  
  names <- unique(provision_with_metadata[act_name == act]$legislation_name)
  names <- names[!is.na(names)]
  
  for (name in names) {
    # Create a clean anchor ID from the legislation name
    anchor_id <- gsub("[^A-Za-z0-9-]", "-", name)
    anchor_id <- gsub("-+", "-", anchor_id)
    anchor_id <- gsub("^-|-$", "", anchor_id)
    anchor_id <- tolower(anchor_id)
    
    cat(sprintf("### %s {#%s}\n\n", name, anchor_id))
    
    # Get all provisions for this legislation
    all_provisions <- provision_with_metadata[act_name == act & legislation_name == name]
    
    if (nrow(all_provisions) > 0) {
      # Order provisions properly - convert Section to numeric where possible
      all_provisions[, Section_numeric := suppressWarnings(as.numeric(Section))]
      setorder(all_provisions, Section_numeric, provision_id)
      
      # Track current heading for display
      current_heading <- ""
      
      # Process provisions in smaller batches to reduce memory pressure
      batch_size <- 50
      n_provisions <- nrow(all_provisions)
      
      for (batch_start in seq(1, n_provisions, by = batch_size)) {
        batch_end <- min(batch_start + batch_size - 1, n_provisions)
        
        for (i in batch_start:batch_end) {
          prov <- all_provisions[i]
          
          # Combine heading and section
          heading_text <- ""
          if (!is.na(prov$Heading) && prov$Heading != "") {
            heading_text <- prov$Heading
          }
          if (!is.na(prov$Section) && prov$Section != "") {
            heading_text <- if (heading_text != "") {
              sprintf("%s | Section %s", heading_text, prov$Section)
            } else {
              sprintf("Section %s", prov$Section)
            }
          }
          
          # Show heading if it changes
          if (heading_text != "" && heading_text != current_heading) {
            current_heading <- heading_text
            cat(sprintf("**%s**\n\n", heading_text))
          }
          
          # Display the paragraph text (truncate if extremely long)
          paragraph_text <- prov$Paragraph
          if (nchar(paragraph_text) > 5000) {
            paragraph_text <- paste0(substr(paragraph_text, 1, 4900), "... [truncated]")
          }
          cat(sprintf("%s", paragraph_text))
          
          # Check for labels - only get what we need
          provision_labels <- provision_label_table[
            provision_id == prov$provision_id,
            .(management_domain, iucn_l2, clause_type, scope)
          ]
          
          if (nrow(provision_labels) > 0) {
            # Process labels more efficiently
            unique_labels <- unique(provision_labels)
            unique_labels[is.na(management_domain), management_domain := ""]
            unique_labels[is.na(iucn_l2), iucn_l2 := ""]
            unique_labels[is.na(clause_type), clause_type := ""]
            unique_labels[is.na(scope), scope := ""]
            
            unique_labels <- unique_labels[
              management_domain != "" | iucn_l2 != "" | clause_type != "" | scope != ""
            ]
            
            if (nrow(unique_labels) > 0) {
              for (j in seq_len(nrow(unique_labels))) {
                label_row <- unique_labels[j]
                label_parts <- c()
                if (label_row$management_domain != "") label_parts <- c(label_parts, label_row$management_domain)
                if (label_row$iucn_l2 != "") label_parts <- c(label_parts, label_row$iucn_l2)
                if (label_row$clause_type != "") label_parts <- c(label_parts, label_row$clause_type)
                if (label_row$scope != "") label_parts <- c(label_parts, label_row$scope)
                
                if (length(label_parts) > 0) {
                  cat(sprintf("\n\n<span style='color: blue; font-style: italic;'>%s</span>", 
                              paste(label_parts, collapse=" | ")))
                }
              }
            }
          }
          
          cat("\n\n")
        }
        
        # Force garbage collection every batch
        if (batch_start %% (batch_size * 5) == 1) {
          invisible(gc())
        }
      }
      
      # Clean up provision-specific data
      rm(all_provisions)
    }
  }
}

# Final cleanup
rm(provision_with_metadata, provision_label_table)
invisible(gc())
```
